note: Upon reflection, I think retreating would have been the smartest move. I think I was trying to take the kill, but retreating to goomy might have been the best move. The opponent would then have had to waste their next energy attaching it to happiny, or retreat and attack with riolu and wouldn't have been able to attack with lucario. This would have given me time to get the dragonair for the energy attaching ability or just the turn based energy I needed to get flygon ready to attack, before exposing him to the danger.
question: At 0-0, with the 20-HP Dratini Active (one Fighting) and Happiny down to 10 HP: after Rare Candy into Flygon ex, would retreating Dratini so that Flygon ex is Active also be a good play? Sand Slammer would knock out Happiny for sure at the Checkup, where Slam only gets it on a heads, but Flygon ex is then exposed early.
